target: PC original - complete the finite campaign, all end encounters, weapon roster, enemy roster, and one recorded score

areas.name: Stage 1
areas.location_cue: The opening green garden crossed by pale paths, square stone borders, and a blue-water bridge.
areas.note: Learn the forced weapon-replacement rule here and preserve the stage-ending checkpoint.

save_backup.title: Keep a checkpoint before the stage ending
save_backup.why: The transition is one-way, and earlier weapon opportunities cannot be revisited in the same run.
save_backup.detail: Preserve a copy before entering the final open space; retain it until the stage checklist is reconciled.

point_of_no_return.title: Stage completion closes this route
point_of_no_return.why: Finishing the last encounter advances beyond the current layout.
point_of_no_return.detail: Use the final open area only after testing new weapons and checking the route behind you.

levels.1: Follow each path until the garden route has no unexplored branch.
levels.2: Cross the water section and continue to the last enclosed clearing.
levels.3: Clear the route, test each weapon pickup before replacing it, then finish the end encounter to trigger STAGE COMPLETE.

items.label: Stage 1 Weapon Sampling

levels.1: Try unfamiliar pickups before replacing them again.
levels.2: Fire every newly collected weapon at least once while ammunition remains.
levels.3: A pickup immediately replaces the weapon in hand and the previous one cannot be selected again. Test it before touching the next pickup, and keep a simple personal checklist across the run.

items.notes_internal: Exact per-stage weapon distribution is not reliably sourced; the guide deliberately avoids inventing it.

levels.1: Save the last open space for after the route sweep.
levels.2: Enter the broad grassy enclosure only after checking the nearby stone paths.
levels.3: Keep moving around the open perimeter, maintain firing distance from the Biotank, and use the strongest currently held ranged weapon until the completion message appears.

areas.note: The streets form several short loops; finish each side lane before crossing onward.

levels.1: Sweep the short streets on both sides of each canal.
levels.2: Continue through the white-stone blocks until the route opens into its last plaza.
levels.3: Finish every reachable street loop, test new weapons before replacement, and clear the final plaza to trigger STAGE COMPLETE.

levels.1: Do not rush the widest paved space after the canal route.
levels.2: Prepare in the last white-stone plaza bordered by water and building blocks.
levels.3: Circle the open paving to preserve distance from the Tyrannosaurus, avoid being pinned against canal edges, and keep sustained fire on it until the stage completion registers.

areas.location_cue: The gold-patterned temple district divided by red-lined walks, blue pools, and small green courts.
areas.note: Keep the final checkpoint until the campaign, arsenal, and score checks are all complete.

levels.1: Treat each colored walkway as a separate branch before moving onward.
levels.2: Sweep the tiled courts around the red-lined paths and blue pools before the final open section.
levels.3: Finish the remaining temple courts, preserve enough ammunition for the last encounter, and clear it to reach the completed-run screen.

levels.1: Keep room to move when the tiled route reaches its broadest court.
levels.2: Prepare in the large patterned plaza beyond the last red-lined passages.
levels.3: Use the open outer floor to avoid close contact with the Giant, keep a clear escape lane between obstacles, and apply continuous fire until the final completion screen appears.

levels.1: A full run rewards experimenting instead of clinging to one pickup.
levels.2: Across all stages, use each distinct weapon before another pickup replaces it.
levels.3: Confirm one use of every weapon: Revolver, Pump Shotgun, Rocket Launcher, Chainsaw, Flamethrower, Minigun, Lasergun, Cannon, and Shocker. If one remains unchecked, reload the earliest suitable stage checkpoint rather than guessing where it appeared.

levels.1: Clear the whole route instead of slipping past optional groups.
levels.2: Visit every reachable branch and defeat each visibly distinct enemy family at least once.
levels.3: A complete route naturally covers Arachnoid, Beheaded Kamikaze, Cucurbito, Gnaar, Kleer Skeleton, Sirian Werebull, Slug, Statue, plus the three stage-ending enemy types. Recheck side lanes if a family was never encountered.

levels.1: Let one uninterrupted run reach its natural results screen.
levels.2: After completing the last stage, confirm that the score table accepts the finished run.
levels.3: Enter a name if prompted and verify the completed score appears in the local high-score table. The table has no finite maximum, so repeated score grinding is not part of completion.
